newsitem.title: USA: KCS Energy sets 1997 spending at $160 mln.
newsitem.headline: KCS Energy sets 1997 spending at $160 mln.

text.p: Oil and gas company KCS Energy Inc said Wednesday it had set a capital spending budget of $160 million for 1997.

The company said it will assign $70 million of the total to development drilling, $25 million to exploration, and $65 million to property acquisitions, including $40 million for acquisitions under its volumetric production payment program.
"We expect to fund approximately 80 (percent) of our program with internally generated funds, and the balance principally through the sale of non-strategic assets," it said.

In February the company signed an agreement to sell its Texas intrastate natural gas pipeline system and related assets to a partnership consisting of a unit of MCN Energy Group Inc and Copano Field Services LLC for $28 million cash.
